user.title: Connect Linkivi
user.description: How do you want to connect Home Assistant to Linkivi?

code.title: Sign in with a code
code.description: Address of your Linkivi. Home Assistant will show a code to check in Linkivi.

key.title: Paste an API key
key.description: Create a key with the "Home Assistant" template in Linkivi (API and webhooks, Pro plan).

reauth_confirm.title: New authorization
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant's access was removed in Linkivi, or the key expired.

reauth_key.title: New API key
reauth_key.description: Paste a new key ("Home Assistant" template).

progress.wait:
Open this link and check the code:

[{url}]({url})

## {code}

Click "Allow" in Linkivi. Waiting for the authorization… The code is valid for 10 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Linkivi cannot be reached at this address.
error.invalid_auth: Key refused: check that it is active and uses the "Home Assistant" template.

abort.wrong_account: This code was allowed in another organisation: the integration keeps its previous access.
abort.cannot_connect: Linkivi cannot be reached at this address.

show_message.name: Show a message
show_message.description: Shows a message over the playlist of the chosen screens, then goes back to the playlist. The screen must be online and awake (or woken by the action).

title.name: Title
title.description: Up to 60 characters. Title or message required.

wake.name: Wake the screen
wake.description: Wakes a sleeping screen for the length of the message (otherwise a sleeping screen refuses).

place.name: Place
place.description: Full screen, or the banner cell that receives messages (full screen if the screen has none).

clear_display.name: Stop the display
clear_display.description: Removes the message: the playlist resumes at once.

show_list.name: Change the playlist
show_list.description: Makes the chosen screens play another playlist: published at once, without approval. All plans.

playlist.name: Playlist
playlist.description: Name of the playlist in Linkivi (or its identifier).

start_emergency.name: Start an emergency alert
start_emergency.description: Red full screen on the chosen screens (on all of them without a target), until "End the emergency alert".

end_emergency.name: End the emergency alert
end_emergency.description: Ends every emergency alert in progress: the playlist resumes.

init.title: Share with Linkivi
init.description: What the Linkivi screens show of this home. Nothing is shared until you choose. Locks and alarms are never shared through a room or a label: choose them one by one.

data.share_commands: Allow screens to control these devices
